# Phase City

A community-governed city built from the ground up in GTA. Built different.

## Pages

- **Home** (https://www.phasecity.net/) — Rules and community guidelines. Your city. Your rules.
- **Store** (https://www.phasecity.net/store.html) — Support Phase City with exclusive VIP packages, 1 of 1 vehicles, custom clothing, and more.
- **Citizen Portal** (https://www.phasecity.net/citizen-portal.html) — Report bugs, suggest features, or submit crash reports.
- **Tools** (https://www.phasecity.net/tools/) — FiveM tools including server scanner, radio frequencies, keybinds, optimizer, ped builder, and more.
